title: Implement Intersecting Lighthouse Light-Refraction Puzzle in PlayScene2
description: Upgrade the twin lighthouse stage (Misty Marsh) in PlayScene2 to feature a cooperative light beam refraction puzzle with carryable items (Ignition Crank and Ancient Prism), asymmetric Father/Child coordination, and laser alignment to unlock the Giant Watermill.
acceptance_criteria: CoopCarryableItem enables picking up, carrying, dropping, and socketing items over Unity Netcode.
Child can retrieve Ignition Crank from narrow rocks; Father cranks West Tower Dynamo to cast primary light beam.
Father lifts fallen log; Child crawls through CoopCrawlVolume to retrieve Ancient Prism from chest.
Child sockets Prism on East Tower; West beam hitting Prism spawns secondary refracted beam.
Aligning refracted beam with LuminaMillSensor triggers BeaconsLit = true, disperses marsh fog, and opens Giant Watermill safety boom.
LevelTwoValidation and batch tests compile and pass cleanly.
test_command: Unity Editor MenuItem: 'Hold My Hand/Level 2/Wire Beacons Watermill and Victory'
risks: Ensure LineRenderer raycasts use layer masks that don't collide prematurely with player colliders.
Ensure backward compatibility of MarshBeaconTrigger.Lit property so GiantWatermillObstacle is unaffected.
